long_biography.plain_text:
United Refrigeration began in Philadelphia as a business created by Reilly's grandparents. His father, John Harvey Reilly Jr, joined young and led the company for thirty-five years, establishing the family succession that later brought John III into leadership. The younger Reilly also holds directorships in associated refrigerant and refrigeration companies in Britain.

After his father's death in 2012, Reilly became president and chief executive of the privately held distributor. Its network now reaches more than 400 locations across the United States and Canada, supplying refrigeration, air-conditioning and heating components to contractors, supermarkets, service businesses and industrial customers. He remains the company's president, chief executive and director as well as a co-owner.
